settings.title: Android Auto turn-by-turn
settings.description: Show Android Auto navigation on the instrument cluster. Do not enable TBT in another mod at the same time.

settings.title: CarPlay / Android Auto junction enlargement (experimental)
settings.description: Enable enlarged guidance for any navigation app when stock road geometry matches the phone's direction and distance. Roundabouts use the received exit angle. If data is insufficient, retain normal TBT.

settings.title: Junction enlargement start distance
settings.description: Choose road-type or speed-based thresholds. Normal TBT remains active where road geometry cannot be verified.

options.title: Local roads: 400 m / highway ramps: 1,050 m

settings.title: Toll plaza approach display (experimental)
settings.description: When a maneuver is identified as a toll plaza within 1 km, send the stock toll display state and distance bar. Identification may fail if the app supplies no toll information.

settings.title: Estimated arrival time format
settings.description: Choose 12-hour, 24-hour or vehicle time settings. Leading zeros and distance decimal formatting cannot be changed here.

settings.title: Experimental Waze guidance recovery
settings.description: Retry the CarPlay guidance subscription when Waze is identified but maneuver data is missing. Also retry once after a silent CarPlay connection. Does not fabricate directions or override phone capabilities.

settings.title: Verbose navigation diagnostics
settings.description: Enable detailed decoded packets and stock display traces for troubleshooting. Normal logging retains lifecycle, source capability, route transitions and errors. Logs may contain private route details.

settings.title: Third-party navigation research trace
settings.description: Record separate Waze, MapQuest and other identified third-party CarPlay navigation packet summaries. Excludes known Apple Maps and Google Maps source names and omits road/destination text. Export completed traces to USB.
